verdict.rationale: Canny's Autopilot is documented as automatically capturing feedback and pulling feature requests out of call transcripts and support, sales and review sources, which covers the automatic insight-detection half of the story. Nothing in the evidence says Autopilot links the extracted insights to existing feature ideas; MCP-driven 'organize requests' is user-directed LLM action, not automatic linking. Missing for 10: documented automatic linking or deduplication of detected insights to related ideas, detail on how the AI detection works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on AI to automatically detect insights within feedback and link them to related feature ideas

citations.quote: Autopilot pulls feature requests out of your Fathom call transcripts automatically.
Autopilot captures feedback from support, sales, and review platforms automatically.
Send new conversations to Autopilot to capture feedback you haven't tracked yet.
